newsitem.title: UK: Southern Electric gains on broker "buy".
newsitem.headline: Southern Electric gains on broker "buy".

text.p: Shares in Southern Electric Plc rose in a firm electricity sector on Friday as analysts at SBC Warburg issued a "buy" recommendation on the stock, market sources said.
Southern was up 12p at 690 by 0958 GMT in modest volume of 404,186 shares -- continuing a rebound from its year's intraday low of 605p set October 17.
Among other electricity stocks, London Electric Plc was up 2p at 607-1/2, Northern Electric Plc was up 1/2p at 601-1/2 and Yorkshire Electrity Plc was up 1p at 729.
Among power generators, National Power Plc was up 6-1/2p at 441-1/2 and PowerGen Plc was up 7p at 561.

Sources said SBC Warburg analysts were positive on Southern in a review of the four UK regional electricity distributors not already either taken over or currently subject of a bid. Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment.
Elsewhere in the sector, East Midlands Electricity Plc is subject of a bid from Dominion Resources of the U.S. while Northern has received a bid from CE Electric, a unit of U.S.-based CalEnergy.
Yet the bids have not yet been given UK regulatory approval and both stocks are trading at discounts to the level of the bids.
